Class GrovePicoShield

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove.GrovePicoShield
public final class GrovePicoShield extends Object
Pin map for Seeed's passive Grove Shield for Pi Pico v1.0 on a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W. The shield adds no protocol or runtime object: every socket is an ordinary Pico pin, so these resolved pins can be passed directly to a Grove driver or to Gpio. Each getter returns the socket's primary SIG pin.

The digital sockets carry the GPIO number in their silkscreen label (D16 is GP16), and the analog sockets A0..A2 are the Pico's ADC pins GP26..GP28, read with Gpio.analogRead. The I2C socket pins are exposed for drivers that wire their own bus; Juno's I2c uses the core's default Wire pins. The UART and SPI sockets are not mapped yet.
